notes: Garruk, Unleashed, printed: '[-2]: Create a 3/3 green Beast creature token. Then if an opponent controls MORE creatures than you, put a loyalty counter on Garruk.' Before the ability I control one creature and the opponent two. The check comes after the Beast ('Then'): two against two is not MORE, so there is no loyalty counter: 4 - 2 = 2, and one 3/3 Beast.
